what.text: This page follows refugees from Nigeria living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5031 Nigerian refugees in the United Kingdom, 1.1% of all refugees from Nigeria.
Niger hosts the most Nigerian refugees, followed by Cameroon, Chad and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nigeria with JAS in 2009 and from 2011 to 2025, and with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over Biafra territory with IPOB from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 10 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
